Frequently Asked Questions

What is the self-employment tax rate?

The self-employment tax rate is 15.3%, which consists of 12.4% for Social Security and 2.9% for Medicare.

When should I consider forming an S-Corp?

If your net profit (gross revenue minus expenses) exceeds $80,000, forming an S-Corp can save you on self-employment taxes by allowing you to take a portion of your income as a distribution, which is not subject to self-employment tax.
